description: This file provides support for Instruction Local Memory (ILM) configuration on the IT8xxx2 platform, including functions to initialize ILM blocks, configure SCAR registers, and manage memory mappings for instruction fetch regions.

methods.name: it8xxx2_is_ilm_configured
methods.description: Checks if the ILM configuration device is ready.

methods.name: is_block_aligned
methods.description: Checks if a memory address is aligned to the ILM block size.

methods.name: it8xxx2_configure_ilm_block
methods.description: Configures a single ILM block by copying data from flash to RAM and setting SCAR registers.

methods.name: it8xxx2_ilm_init
methods.description: Initializes ILM by configuring all ILM blocks based on linker symbols.
